name: RavenShield
description: Free, privacy-first deception security platform for the AI era. Plant decoy credentials and trap facts, firewall prompt injection, and bait attackers with an AI honeypot. Every event is sealed into a SHA-256 tamper-evident evidence chain. Includes secret scanning, phishing analysis and breach checks, all running locally in your browser.

paragraphs: Free deception security for the AI era. Plant decoys, catch leaks, firewall prompt injection, bait attackers, and seal everything into a tamper-evident evidence chain. 100% free, with free accounts, and runs entirely in the browser.
features: Secret Scanner: 28 provider detectors plus entropy analysis. Scans files and folders; exports a redacted copy and a CSV.
Password Forge: pattern-aware strength estimate, HIBP k-anonymity breach check, and a password/passphrase generator.
Phish Lens: offline URL dissection (lookalikes, homoglyphs, punycode, brand impersonation, shorteners and more).
Integrity Hasher: SHA-256/384/512/1 for files and text, checksum compare, SHA256SUMS export, and notarization.
Evidence Console (dashboard.html): a single timeline across every tool, with chain verification, filters, chart, JSON/CSV/PDF export, import and desktop alerts.
